design: Use all twelve conditions, seed 0 and all five original draws; additionally all five seeds and five draws of NHANES age (headline worst-class condition for OT and LR-QR). This gives 80 paired calibration problems, without choosing cases by favorable outcome.

lrqr.lambda: reuse increased-budget CV selection, never target-test selection

controls: OT two-support score distributions with independently enumerated piecewise-quadratic global simplex minimum, including objective evaluation agreement; LR-QR intercept-only model with closed-form global pinball-loss minimum and beta*h=1. Retain all objective gaps and failures.
measurements: Calibration objective, optimization/stationarity diagnostics, selected hyperparameters, target marginal/class coverage, empty/singleton/full-set rates, correct and incorrect singleton masses. Compare paired effects, all conditions and full worst-condition seeds/draws. No pooled deployment significance test.
stopping: Fixed budgets, no extra iterations based on favorable test performance; if findings materially change, revise the headline conclusions and retain baseline results.
